title: ¡Compartir es más dulce! 🎃🐭 #shorts
world: Halloween night village street: three tiny round houses (orange, purple, mint) with friendly jack-o-lanterns, paper lanterns, autumn leaves, big full moon + Tito's orange front door
lyrics:
[Verse 3]
Un ratoncito sin dulces…
¿Qué hará Tito? ¿Qué hará?
¡Comparte su dulce! ¡Toma!
¡Ahora los dos están felices!
[Chorus]
¡Dulce, dulce, Halloween!
¡Gracias, gracias, qué feliz!
Un dulce para ti, un dulce para mí…
¡calabaza, a seguir!
story: Second 0: a tiny mouse with an EMPTY bucket, sad (hook)
Tito sees it, kneels, sets his bucket down
He gives candies from his open palm into the mouse's bucket
They dance, bow, show one candy each, and walk on together

Nobody is on the street.

The mouse fills the lower two thirds of the frame. The main action is in the CENTER of the frame.

START: the mouse looks into its empty bucket → ACTION: on 'sin dulces' its ears droop and it gives a tiny sad sigh (SAD-SMALL) → END: it looks up hopefully. Paper lanterns sway gently, a few autumn leaves drift down, jack-o-lanterns flicker softly. Both eyes stay open and calm with the same gentle expression the whole time.
